identification: 'Magic Wheel' style foot-propelled one-wheel skate/scooter (non-electric): a single bicycle-size spoked wheel (yellow/black rim decal, red reflector) housed in a black moulded plastic shell with red flare stripes, carry-handle slot at the top, low foot platform at the base, and a small rear castor wheel on an outrigger for steering/balance. The hub is a plain 12-bolt plate with axle nut: no motor, battery, switch or charge port visible. This matches the Magic Wheel launched in the UK in 2008 (about GBP 80-119 new), which you ride like a skateboard, one foot on the platform and kicking with the other; cheap copies are still sold online as 'Magic Wheel Scooter Penny Farthing'.
